issue.title: -r option to resume a session is missing in --help

relevant_locations.role: Entry point for CLI initialization and option parsing

llm_context.input_title: -r option to resume a session is missing in --help
llm_context.input_body: No body provided in issue description.

generated_output.summary: The CLI exit message tells users to resume sessions using the `-r` option (e.g. `kimi -r session_xxx`), but running `kimi --help` shows that the actual command line option defined is `-S, --session`, causing user confusion.
generated_output.root_cause_analysis: The exit banner or session manager message formatting uses `-r`, whereas the Commander.js CLI configuration defines session resumption under `-S, --session` without registering `-r` as an alias or option.

step_by_step_plan.title: Inspect CLI Option Configuration
step_by_step_plan.description: Inspect apps/kimi-code/src/main.ts to examine how Commander.js or the underlying CLI parser registers the session option and verify if `-r` can be added as a short option alias alongside `-S, --session`.

step_by_step_plan.title: Add `-r` Short Flag Alias
step_by_step_plan.description: Update the CLI option definition in apps/kimi-code/src/main.ts to support `-r, -S, --session <id>` so that both `-r` and `-S` correctly map to the session resumption option, matching the exit message prompt.

step_by_step_plan.title: Verify Help Output and Option Parsing
step_by_step_plan.description: Run manual verification or CLI tests to ensure that `kimi --help` displays the `-r` option correctly and that parsing `kimi -r <session_id>` correctly populates the session resumption parameter.

step_by_step_plan.title: Run Test Suite
step_by_step_plan.description: Execute the repository test suite using the verified test command to ensure no regressions were introduced by adding the `-r` flag alias.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Allowing multiple command-line flags (like -S and -r) to point to the exact same underlying option.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Ensures that user documentation, error messages, and actual CLI parser capabilities remain perfectly in sync so users aren't given broken instructions.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: Fixes the discrepancy where the exit message instructs users to use `-r`, but only `-S` is recognized by the CLI.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: The self-documenting usage and option descriptions generated by CLI parsing libraries such as Commander.js.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Developers rely on help text to discover available flags and correct syntax without needing to check external documentation.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: Ensures that whichever option flag (-r or -S) is chosen as the canonical resumption method is clearly documented in `kimi --help`.

common_pitfalls: Changing only the exit message without adding the `-r` alias support to the CLI parser (or vice versa), leaving the underlying mismatch unresolved.
